program_overview.title: Princess Coders
program_overview.tagline: A supportive room changes everything: girls and women learning to code together, from first tag to a deployed full-stack project in nine honest months.
program_overview.description:
Women remain outnumbered in tech for reasons that have nothing to do with ability and a lot to do with rooms. Princess Coders fixes the room: live online batches of girls and women learning together, taught the complete beginner-to-builder arc: HTML, CSS and JavaScript foundations, modern React with TypeScript, backend basics with Node and databases, and a deployed capstone, with a dedicated week on women-in-tech community, mentorship and visibility.

The teaching is rigorous and the tone is warm; those were never opposites. Homework follows every class, monthly assignments mix new material with earlier topics so skills compound, each phase ends with an exam, and the course ends with a final exam that decides the certificate, with a free retest after revision.

Nine months at two live classes a week plus three to four hours of practice, with two more months in hand when needed. Real code, real support, real momentum.
what_makes_this_different: The room is the feature: girls and women learning together, taught by instructors who take them seriously
The complete arc: foundations to React to backend basics to a deployed capstone, not a taster
Modern stack throughout: JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Node and real deployment
A women-in-tech week that is practical: community, mentorship and visibility, not slogans
An honest 9-month arc with 2 months in hand: nobody is rushed
Real assessment: weekly homework, monthly mixed reviews, and a final exam that decides the certificate, with a free retest

faqs.question: What is Princess Coders, and who is it for?
faqs.answer: A complete beginner-to-builder coding course taught in batches of girls and women: school students (13+), college students and career switchers learning together in a supportive, serious room. The arc runs HTML, CSS and JavaScript foundations, modern React with TypeScript, backend basics with Node and databases, and ends with a deployed full-stack capstone and a final exam.

faqs.question: Why a women-only coding course?
faqs.answer: Because rooms matter. Women are still outnumbered in most tech classrooms, and many learn faster and speak up more in a batch where that pressure is gone. The syllabus is identical in rigor to any of our courses, the exams are real, and the community that forms tends to outlast graduation.

faqs.question: How long does it take to go from zero to building real applications?
faqs.answer: Nine months at 2 live classes a week plus 3 to 4 hours of practice, with two more months in hand for learners who need them. The first deployed project ships within phase 1; the full-stack capstone lands at month nine.

faqs.question: How is progress assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Homework follows every class, each month ends with an assignment that deliberately mixes new questions with earlier topics, every phase closes with a cumulative exam, and the course ends with a final exam. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: What comes after Princess Coders?
faqs.answer: Whatever road called loudest: our full-stack course for depth, DSA for interviews, AI courses for the modern layer, and for women who grow into engineering careers, Queen Coders, our advanced engineering and technical-leadership course. The capstone and portfolio built here carry into all of them.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial class?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo class with no commitment: book at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups with a real instructor, never pre-recorded videos.
